text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing training with Wonder Acute 
on that day, I was preparing to pack up, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, would you mind if I did a little more 
training?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's nothing major, really... Here, 
take a look over there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Alright, just a little bit more today...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*~... Maybe I'll run just a 
little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Basking in all that fiery passion warmed 
up both my body and heart.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Since you're all warmed up, seems a waste 
not to run... What do you think?
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it one more push!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Is that true? Thank you. It makes me 
happy to hear you say that."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'm going to keep training 
just a little bit longer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Wonder Acute kept running 
passionately until the sun had completely 
set.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. To be fair, I did finish 
everything I needed to do today..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Getting swept up in the heat to the point 
where one can't tell if they are 
overworking is quite dangerous, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's call it a day today. Instead, 
maybe I'll take my time pickling some 
crunchy snacks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we successfully prevented Wonder 
Acute from overworking herself.
